questions.cardText:
[Economics] The concept of the “invisible hand,” as introduced by Adam Smith, implies that:
A. Inequality is a natural outcome of market forces
B. Inflation and deflation are self-regulating in any economic system
C. Market economies regulate themselves through competition and self-interest, leading to societal benefit
Answer: C. This metaphor was only mentioned once in Adam Smith’s “The Wealth of Nations” but has since become a central idea in classical economics.
questions.de: Welche Metapher, die Adam Smith in „Der Wohlstand der Nationen“ nur ein einziges Mal verwendet, beschreibt, wie Menschen, die auf dem Markt ihr Eigeninteresse verfolgen, unbeabsichtigt der Gesellschaft nützen?
questions.en: What metaphor, used just once in Adam Smith's “The Wealth of Nations”, describes how individuals pursuing their self-interest in a market unintentionally benefit society?

timeline.labelEn: Adam Smith publishes The Wealth of Nations, with its single mention of an “invisible hand”
timeline.labelDe: Adam Smith veröffentlicht „Der Wohlstand der Nationen“ mit der einzigen Erwähnung einer „unsichtbaren Hand“

questions.notes: Card's answer confirmed. 'Mentioned once' is true of The Wealth of Nations only; Smith also used the phrase once in The Theory of Moral Sentiments (1759).

questions.cardText:
[Physiology and Anatomy] What is the powerhouse of the cell?
A. Nucleus B. Ribosome C. Mitochondria
Answer: C. Mitochondria, known as the cell’s powerhouse, are unique in having their own DNA, a trait indicative of their evolutionary history.
questions.de: Welches Zellorganell wird im Volksmund „Kraftwerk der Zelle“ genannt?
questions.en: Which organelle is popularly nicknamed the “powerhouse of the cell”?

timeline.labelEn: Philip Siekevitz popularises “powerhouse of the cell” for the mitochondrion in a Scientific American article
timeline.labelDe: Philip Siekevitz macht „Kraftwerk der Zelle“ für das Mitochondrium in einem Artikel im Scientific American populär

questions.notes: Card's answer confirmed. Its explanation errs: mitochondria are not unique in having their own DNA, plant chloroplasts (plastids) have their own genome too.
